annotation.title: The CST layout could be vertically condensed much as the aux inputs were, investigate and cleanup

result: Condensed the CST section from 49 to 42 mm high and channel pitch from 23 to 17 mm. All 41 CST2 components match their CST1 counterparts at a 17 mm translation. Repacked raw/envelope branches, rebuilt matching local copper, and shortened the shared supplies and CST2 ADC/zero-crossing links.
changes: J60 is at (29,147) mm; J40 remains at (29,130) mm.
Lifted each raw/envelope lower loop and retained local supply bypass placement, probes and ground returns.
CST frame bottom is y=162 mm; its caption is at y=160.5 mm.
Updated the canonical placement/routing recipes and circuit contract positions.
quality_assessment: Native KiCad physical DRC is clean. The separate quality audit retains its existing backlog; raw counts are 302 errors and 2400 warnings versus 288 and 2401 before.

All 28 added error identities are board-silk geometry false positives: KCT subtracts the board origin from footprints but not board graphics. The reported crossings disappear when using the actual native coordinates, with a minimum conservative gap of 24.1 mm. Exact measurements and parser evidence are in cst-condense-checks/quality-geometry-assessment.json.

Warning identities do not increase. C613 retains its existing pad-grid warning; U62 midpoint-to-capacitor distance improves from 3.24 to 3.16 mm. Other distance messages reflect the moved row. No rules or thresholds were relaxed.
visual_review: Inspected actual pcbnew copper, pad, silkscreen and courtyard geometry: matching shallow rows, clear inter-row spacing, left-facing connectors, accessible probes, retained nearby bypasses, and updated frame/caption.
scope_boundary: CST placement and associated copper only. All component values, footprints, pin nets, ADC mapping, board outline, mounting holes, other circuits, schematic and project settings are unchanged. No fabrication outputs generated.
tools: native pcbnew scope and connectivity audits
